_meta.description: Registry of assumption keys and the cloud services, charge types, mappers, and pricing decisions they control.

nat_vms_per_gateway.decision_it_changes: Cloud NAT gateway hourly fee: scales per-VM hourly rate by assumed VMs per gateway rather than a flat single-VM charge.

dax_node_gib.decision_it_changes: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) node-hours: converts node-hours into Memorystore for Redis RAM GiB-hours.

memorydb_node_gib.decision_it_changes: Amazon MemoryDB for Redis node-hours: converts node-hours into Memorystore for Redis RAM GiB-hours.

glue_dpu_vcpu.decision_it_changes: AWS Glue DPU-hours: decomposes standard DPU worker hours into Cloud Dataflow / Compute Engine vCPU worker hours.

glue_dpu_ram_gib.decision_it_changes: AWS Glue DPU-hours: decomposes standard DPU worker hours into Cloud Dataflow / Compute Engine memory GiB worker hours.

looker_studio_pro_seat_usd.decision_it_changes: Amazon QuickSight user-month subscriptions: prices user seats using Looker Studio Pro list price.

aurora_acu_vcpu.decision_it_changes: Aurora Serverless v2 ACU-hours: maps 1 ACU into Cloud SQL Custom vCPU equivalent.

aurora_acu_ram_gib.decision_it_changes: Aurora Serverless v2 ACU-hours: maps 1 ACU into Cloud SQL Custom RAM GiB equivalent.

lambda_mb_per_vcpu.decision_it_changes: AWS Lambda memory-duration: derives Cloud Run vCPU-seconds and memory GiB-seconds from allocated memory ratio.

inferentia_chip_to_tpu.decision_it_changes: AWS Inferentia instance hours: maps Inferentia accelerator chips to Cloud TPU v5e chip-hours using declared chip ratio.

trainium_chip_to_tpu.decision_it_changes: AWS Trainium instance hours: maps Trainium accelerator chips to Cloud TPU v5e chip-hours using declared chip ratio.

dynamodb_rcu_to_reads_sec.decision_it_changes: DynamoDB provisioned Read Capacity Units: maps provisioned RCU-hours to Cloud Firestore / Bigtable read operations.

dynamodb_wcu_to_writes_sec.decision_it_changes: DynamoDB provisioned Write Capacity Units: maps provisioned WCU-hours to Cloud Firestore / Bigtable write operations.

rds_iops_included_in_storage.decision_it_changes: RDS/Aurora provisioned IOPS: 1.0 treats IOPS as folded into Cloud SQL storage ($0), 0.0 prices separately as passthrough.

aws_ri_1yr_discount_pct.decision_it_changes: 1-Year Reserved Instance reconstruction: reconstructs AWS Public On-Demand cost baseline for 1-year RI covered usage.

aws_ri_3yr_discount_pct.decision_it_changes: 3-Year Reserved Instance reconstruction: reconstructs AWS Public On-Demand cost baseline for 3-year RI covered usage.

aws_sp_discount_pct.decision_it_changes: Savings Plans reconstruction: reconstructs AWS Public On-Demand cost baseline for Compute & EC2 Savings Plans usage.

aws_spot_discount_pct.decision_it_changes: Spot instance reconstruction: reconstructs AWS Public On-Demand cost baseline for Spot-discounted usage.

fx_max_staleness_days.decision_it_changes: Maximum allowable staleness in days for FX rates before flagging [fx-stale] diagnostic.
